title: Juicy Smoky Sicilian Pork Lasagna
description: A smoky and savory one-pot Italian dish featuring pork, lasagna noodles, and a blend of cheeses, cooked to perfection in an air fryer.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the ground pork over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, shredded mozzarella, and grated parmesan.
In a separate bowl, combine the marinara sauce and chopped fresh basil.
In the air fryer basket, create a thin layer of marinara sauce.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the noodles, followed by half of the cooked pork mixture.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the marinara sauce, then the remaining ricotta cheese mixture, and finally the remaining pork mixture.
Top the lasagna with the remaining shredded mozzarella cheese.
Cook the lasagna in the air fryer for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
